welcome_page.title: Welcome to Your Experience With Driving
welcome_page.description:
This SmartUrbanity questionnaire asks about how you feel and what you experience while travelling by car. Your answers help identify barriers and opportunities for better urban mobility. Participation is voluntary. Your answers are not linked to your name. They are stored under a pseudonymous code derived from your email address, so that your answers to different SmartUrbanity questionnaires can be analysed together.

Learn more about SmartUrbanity

final_page.title: Thank you!
final_page.description: Your submission has been recorded. Thank you for taking the time to complete the questionnaire.

sections.title: Car Travel
sections.description: Questions about your relationship with car travel and alternatives.

questions.text: Do you drive a car at least once a week to get to places? Count only the trips in which you are the driver.
Why don't you drive more often? (Select all that apply)

options.text: I don't have a driving licence
I don't have a car available
My health, a disability or my age makes it difficult
I don't need to: other ways of getting around suit me better

questions.text: What would motivate you to use sustainable travel modes (walking, cycling, public transport, shared vehicles) more often?

options.text: More frequent and reliable public transport, also in the evening
Better walking, cycling, or micromobility infrastructure
Shorter or more reliable travel times
Feeling more confident or secure using these modes
Routes and vehicles that are accessible for my disability or health condition
I need the car for my situation (e.g., disability, children, loads, work shifts)
I am not interested in using these modes more often

questions.text: If you were given free access to a shared bicycle or e-scooter, would you use it?

options.text: I could not use them for health or disability reasons

questions.text: When delays occur (e.g., congestion, crashes), how do they affect your stress levels?
How much do delays (e.g., traffic, congestion, crashes) change your daily schedule?
How do congestion levels influence your route choice or departure time?

options.text: Moderately (sometimes change route or departure time)
Always (plan trips specifically to avoid congestion)

questions.text: How would increased driving-related costs (fuel, tolls, parking, permits for limited traffic zones) affect your car usage?

options.text: Would stop using car for most trips
I could not reduce it: I have no alternative

questions.text: To what extent do emissions concerns influence your travel behavior?

options.text: Not at all, emissions concerns do not influence my travel choices
Slightly, I occasionally think about emissions when choosing how to travel
Moderately, emissions concerns sometimes influence my travel decisions
Strongly, emissions concerns regularly affect how I travel
Very strongly, I actively try to reduce car use because of emissions concerns

questions.text: How comfortable do you find traveling by car compared to other modes?
How often is finding a parking space at your destination a problem for you?
If you have a disabled parking permit: how often are the reserved spaces at your destination occupied by others or missing?

options.text: I don't have a disabled parking permit

questions.text: How do parking difficulties typically affect your travel decisions?

options.text: They make my journey less convenient or more stressful
They make me change my route or destination
They make me postpone, avoid, or cancel some trips
They make me choose another mode of transport instead of driving
They do not affect my travel decisions

it.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Dr: SmartUrbanity - La tua esperienza con l'auto
it.#Welcome to Your Experience With Driving: Benvenuto/a nel questionario sulla tua esperienza con l'auto
it.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: La tua risposta è stata registrata. Grazie per il tempo dedicato alla compilazione del questionario.
it.#<p>Questions about your relationship wi: Domande sul tuo rapporto con gli spostamenti in auto e con le modalità alternative.
it.#Better walking, cycling, or micromobili: Migliori infrastrutture pedonali, ciclabili o per la micromobilità
it.#Shorter or more reliable travel times: Tempi di spostamento più brevi o più affidabili
it.#Feeling more confident or secure using: Sentirmi più sicuro/a e a mio agio nell'utilizzare queste modalità
it.#Environmental concerns or sustainabilit: Preoccupazioni ambientali o valori legati alla sostenibilità
it.#I am not interested in using these mode: Non sono interessato/a a utilizzare più spesso queste modalità
it.#If you were given free access to a shar: Se avessi accesso gratuito a una bicicletta condivisa o a un monopattino elettrico, lo utilizzeresti?
it.#How do congestion levels influence your: In che modo i livelli di congestione influenzano la scelta del percorso o dell'orario di partenza?
it.#Slightly (occasionally adjust route or: Poco (occasionalmente modifico il percorso o l'orario)
it.#Moderately (sometimes change route or d: Moderatamente (a volte cambio il percorso o l'orario di partenza)
it.#Strongly (frequently change route or ti: Molto (cambio frequentemente il percorso o l'orario)
it.#Always (plan trips specifically to avoi: Sempre (pianifico appositamente gli spostamenti per evitare la congestione)
it.#Would stop using car for most trips: Smetterei di utilizzare l'auto per la maggior parte degli spostamenti
it.#To what extent do emissions concerns in: In che misura le preoccupazioni relative alle emissioni influenzano le tue scelte di spostamento?
it.#Not at all, emissions concerns do not i: Per niente, le preoccupazioni relative alle emissioni non influenzano le mie scelte di spostamento
it.#Slightly, I occasionally think about em: Poco, occasionalmente penso alle emissioni quando scelgo come spostarmi
it.#Moderately, emissions concerns sometime: Moderatamente, le preoccupazioni relative alle emissioni a volte influenzano le mie decisioni di spostamento
it.#Strongly, emissions concerns regularly: Molto, le preoccupazioni relative alle emissioni influenzano regolarmente il mio modo di spostarmi
it.#Very strongly, I actively try to reduce: Moltissimo, cerco attivamente di ridurre l'uso dell'auto a causa delle preoccupazioni relative alle emissioni
it.#How comfortable do you find traveling b: Quanto trovi confortevole viaggiare in auto rispetto ad altre modalità di trasporto?
it.#How do parking difficulties typically a: In che modo le difficoltà di parcheggio influenzano normalmente le tue decisioni di spostamento?
it.#They do not affect my travel decisions: Non influenzano le mie decisioni di spostamento
it.#They make my journey less convenient or: Rendono il mio spostamento meno comodo o più stressante
it.#They make me change my route or destina: Mi portano a cambiare percorso o destinazione
it.#They make me postpone, avoid, or cancel: Mi portano a rimandare, evitare o annullare alcuni spostamenti
it.#They make me choose another mode of tra: Mi portano a scegliere un'altra modalità di trasporto invece dell'auto
it.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Questo questionario SmartUrbanity riguarda le tue sensazioni e le tue esperienze durante gli spostamenti in auto. Le tue risposte ci aiutano a individuare ostacoli e opportunità per migliorare la mobilità urbana. La partecipazione è volontaria. Le tue risposte non sono collegate al tuo nome: vengono salvate con un codice pseudonimo ricavato dal tuo indirizzo email, così che le risposte ai diversi questionari SmartUrbanity possano essere analizzate insieme.

Scopri di più su SmartUrbanity
it.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: Guidi un'auto almeno una volta alla settimana per i tuoi spostamenti? Considera solo gli spostamenti in cui sei tu alla guida.
it.#Why don't you drive more often? (Select: Perché non guidi più spesso? (Seleziona tutte le opzioni applicabili)
it.#My health, a disability or my age makes: La mia salute, una disabilità o l'età me lo rendono difficile
it.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Non mi serve: altri modi di spostarmi sono più adatti a me
it.#What would motivate you to use sustaina: Cosa ti motiverebbe a utilizzare più spesso modalità di trasporto sostenibili (a piedi, in bicicletta, trasporto pubblico, mezzi condivisi)?
it.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Un trasporto pubblico più frequente e affidabile, anche di sera
it.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: Percorsi e mezzi accessibili per la mia disabilità o condizione di salute
it.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: Per le mie esigenze l'auto è necessaria (ad es. disabilità, figli, carichi, turni di lavoro)
it.#I could not use them for health or disa: Non potrei usarli per motivi di salute o disabilità
it.#When delays occur (e.g., congestion, cr: Quando si verificano ritardi (ad esempio per congestione o incidenti), in che modo influiscono sul tuo livello di stress?
it.#How much do delays (e.g., traffic, cong: Quanto i ritardi (ad es. per traffico, congestione o incidenti) cambiano i tuoi impegni quotidiani?
it.#How would increased driving-related cos: In che modo un aumento dei costi legati all'uso dell'auto (carburante, pedaggi, parcheggio, permessi per le zone a traffico limitato) influenzerebbe il tuo utilizzo dell'auto?
it.#I could not reduce it: I have no altern: Non potrei ridurlo: non ho alternative
it.#How often is finding a parking space at: Quanto spesso trovare parcheggio a destinazione è un problema per te?
it.#If you have a disabled parking permit:: Se hai il contrassegno per persone con disabilità: quanto spesso i posti riservati a destinazione sono occupati da altri o mancano del tutto?
it.#I don't have a disabled parking permit: Non ho il contrassegno per persone con disabilità

fr.#SmartUrbanity - Your Experience With Dr: SmartUrbanity - Votre expérience de la conduite
fr.#Welcome to Your Experience With Driving: Bienvenue dans le questionnaire sur votre expérience de la conduite
fr.#<p>Your submission has been recorded. T: Votre réponse a bien été enregistrée. Merci d’avoir pris le temps de remplir ce questionnaire.
fr.#<p>Questions about your relationship wi: Questions sur vos déplacements en voiture et les autres possibilités de transport.
fr.#Lower travel costs: Des coûts de déplacement plus faibles
fr.#Safer routes and environments: Des itinéraires et des environnements plus sûrs
fr.#Better walking, cycling, or micromobili: De meilleures infrastructures pour la marche, le vélo ou la micromobilité
fr.#Shorter or more reliable travel times: Des temps de trajet plus courts ou plus fiables
fr.#Better weather or climate conditions: De meilleures conditions météo ou climatiques
fr.#Greater comfort and convenience: Plus de confort et de facilité
fr.#Feeling more confident or secure using: Me sentir plus en confiance ou en sécurité avec ces modes
fr.#Environmental concerns or sustainabilit: Des préoccupations environnementales ou des valeurs liées au développement durable
fr.#I am not interested in using these mode: Je ne souhaite pas utiliser ces modes plus souvent
fr.#If you were given free access to a shar: Si vous aviez gratuitement accès à un vélo partagé ou à une trottinette électrique, l’utiliseriez-vous ?
fr.#How do congestion levels influence your: Dans quelle mesure les embouteillages influencent-ils votre choix d’itinéraire ou votre heure de départ ?
fr.#Slightly (occasionally adjust route or: Un peu (je change parfois d’itinéraire ou d’horaire)
fr.#Moderately (sometimes change route or d: Modérément (je change parfois d’itinéraire ou d’heure de départ)
fr.#Strongly (frequently change route or ti: Beaucoup (je change souvent d’itinéraire ou d’horaire)
fr.#Always (plan trips specifically to avoi: Toujours (j’organise mes déplacements pour éviter les embouteillages)
fr.#Slight reduction in car use: Une légère réduction de mon usage de la voiture
fr.#Moderate reduction in car use: Une réduction modérée de mon usage de la voiture
fr.#Significant reduction in car use: Une forte réduction de mon usage de la voiture
fr.#Would stop using car for most trips: J’arrêterais d’utiliser la voiture pour la plupart de mes déplacements
fr.#To what extent do emissions concerns in: Dans quelle mesure les émissions polluantes influencent-elles vos choix de déplacement ?
fr.#Not at all, emissions concerns do not i: Pas du tout : les émissions n’influencent pas mes choix de déplacement
fr.#Slightly, I occasionally think about em: Un peu : je pense parfois aux émissions quand je choisis comment me déplacer
fr.#Moderately, emissions concerns sometime: Modérément : les émissions influencent parfois mes décisions de déplacement
fr.#Strongly, emissions concerns regularly: Beaucoup : les émissions influencent régulièrement ma façon de me déplacer
fr.#Very strongly, I actively try to reduce: Énormément : j’essaie activement de moins utiliser la voiture à cause des émissions
fr.#How comfortable do you find traveling b: Par rapport aux autres modes de transport, trouvez-vous les déplacements en voiture confortables ?
fr.#How do parking difficulties typically a: Comment les difficultés de stationnement influencent-elles généralement vos décisions de déplacement ?
fr.#They do not affect my travel decisions: Elles n’influencent pas mes décisions de déplacement
fr.#They make my journey less convenient or: Elles rendent mon trajet moins pratique ou plus stressant
fr.#They make me change my route or destina: Elles me font changer d’itinéraire ou de destination
fr.#They make me postpone, avoid, or cancel: Elles me font reporter, éviter ou annuler certains déplacements
fr.#They make me choose another mode of tra: Elles me font choisir un autre mode de transport au lieu de conduire
fr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Ce questionnaire SmartUrbanity porte sur vos sensations et votre expérience lors de vos déplacements en voiture. Vos réponses nous aident à repérer les obstacles et les possibilités d’amélioration de la mobilité urbaine. La participation est volontaire. Vos réponses ne sont pas associées à votre nom : elles sont enregistrées sous un code pseudonyme dérivé de votre adresse e-mail, afin que vos réponses aux différents questionnaires SmartUrbanity puissent être analysées ensemble.

En savoir plus sur SmartUrbanity

fr.#Why don't you drive more often? (Select: Pourquoi ne conduisez-vous pas plus souvent ? (Sélectionnez toutes les réponses qui s’appliquent)
fr.#I don't have a driving licence: Je n'ai pas le permis de conduire
fr.#I don't have a car available: Je n'ai pas de voiture à disposition
fr.#Parking is hard to find: Il est difficile de trouver une place de stationnement
fr.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Ma santé, un handicap ou mon âge rendent cela difficile

fr.#What would motivate you to use sustaina: Qu’est-ce qui vous encouragerait à utiliser plus souvent des modes de déplacement durables, comme la marche, le vélo, les transports en commun ou les véhicules partagés ?
fr.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Des transports en commun plus fréquents et plus fiables, y compris le soir
fr.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: Des itinéraires et des véhicules accessibles compte tenu de mon handicap ou de mon état de santé
fr.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: J'ai besoin de la voiture dans ma situation (par ex. handicap, enfants, charges, horaires de travail décalés)
fr.#I could not use them for health or disa: Je ne pourrais pas les utiliser pour des raisons de santé ou de handicap
fr.#When delays occur (e.g., congestion, cr: Quand il y a des retards, par exemple à cause des embouteillages ou d’un accident, quel effet ont-ils sur votre niveau de stress ?
fr.#How much do delays (e.g., traffic, cong: Dans quelle mesure les retards (par ex. circulation, embouteillages, accidents) modifient-ils votre emploi du temps quotidien ?
fr.#How would increased driving-related cos: Si les coûts liés à la conduite augmentaient, par exemple le carburant, les péages, le stationnement ou les permis d’accès aux zones à circulation limitée, quel effet cela aurait-il sur votre usage de la voiture ?

de.#Moderate reduction in car use: Ich würde das Auto deutlich weniger nutzen
de.#Significant reduction in car use: Ich würde das Auto viel weniger nutzen
de.#Would stop using car for most trips: Ich würde für die meisten Wege auf das Auto verzichten

de.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Dieser SmartUrbanity-Fragebogen befasst sich damit, wie Sie Autofahrten erleben und wie Sie sich dabei fühlen. Ihre Antworten helfen uns, Hindernisse und Möglichkeiten für eine bessere städtische Mobilität zu erkennen. Die Teilnahme ist freiwillig. Ihre Antworten werden nicht mit Ihrem Namen verknüpft: Sie werden unter einem pseudonymen Code gespeichert, der aus Ihrer E-Mail-Adresse abgeleitet wird, damit Ihre Antworten auf die verschiedenen SmartUrbanity-Fragebögen gemeinsam ausgewertet werden können.

tr.#Welcome to Your Experience With Driving: Otomobil Kullanma Deneyimi Anketine Hoş Geldiniz

tr.#Feeling more confident or secure using: Bu ulaşım seçeneklerini kullanırken kendimi daha güvende hissetmek
tr.#Environmental concerns or sustainabilit: Çevreyle ilgili kaygılar veya sürdürülebilirlik değerleri

tr.#Moderately (sometimes change route or d: Orta düzeyde (bazen güzergâhı veya çıkış saatini değiştiririm)
tr.#Strongly (frequently change route or ti: Çok (sık sık güzergâhı veya saati değiştiririm)
tr.#Always (plan trips specifically to avoi: Her zaman (yolculuklarımı özellikle sıkışıklıktan kaçınacak şekilde planlarım)
tr.#Moderate reduction in car use: Otomobili orta düzeyde daha az kullanırdım
tr.#Significant reduction in car use: Otomobili belirgin şekilde daha az kullanırdım
tr.#To what extent do emissions concerns in: Emisyonlarla ilgili kaygılar ulaşım tercihlerinizi ne ölçüde etkiler?
tr.#Not at all, emissions concerns do not i: Hiç etkilemez: emisyon kaygıları ulaşım tercihlerimi değiştirmez
tr.#Slightly, I occasionally think about em: Biraz etkiler: nasıl gideceğime karar verirken bazen emisyonları düşünürüm
tr.#Moderately, emissions concerns sometime: Orta düzeyde etkiler: emisyon kaygıları bazen kararlarımı etkiler
tr.#Strongly, emissions concerns regularly: Çok etkiler: emisyon kaygıları ulaşım şeklimi düzenli olarak etkiler

tr.#How do parking difficulties typically a: Park etme güçlükleri ulaşım kararlarınızı genellikle nasıl etkiler?
tr.#They make my journey less convenient or: Yolculuğumu daha zahmetli veya daha stresli hale getirir
tr.#They make me change my route or destina: Güzergâhımı veya gideceğim yeri değiştirmeme neden olur
tr.#They make me postpone, avoid, or cancel: Bazı yolculukları ertelememe, yapmamama veya iptal etmeme neden olur
tr.#They make me choose another mode of tra: Otomobil yerine başka bir ulaşım seçeneği kullanmama neden olur
tr.#<p>This SmartUrbanity questionnaire ask:
Bu SmartUrbanity anketi otomobille yolculuk ederken neler yaşadığınız ve nasıl hissettiğinizle ilgilidir. Yanıtlarınız, daha iyi kentsel hareketlilik için engelleri ve iyileştirme fırsatlarını belirlememize yardımcı olur. Katılım gönüllüdür. Yanıtlarınız adınızla ilişkilendirilmez: farklı SmartUrbanity anketlerine verdiğiniz yanıtların birlikte analiz edilebilmesi için e-posta adresinizden türetilen takma adlı bir kodla saklanır.

SmartUrbanity hakkında daha fazla bilgi edinin
tr.#Do you drive a car at least once a week: Bir yerlere gitmek için haftada en az bir kez otomobil kullanıyor musunuz? Yalnızca direksiyonda sizin olduğunuz yolculukları sayın.

tr.#My health, a disability or my age makes: Sağlığım, bir engelim veya yaşım bunu zorlaştırıyor
tr.#I don't need to: other ways of getting: Gerek duymuyorum: başka ulaşım yolları bana daha uygun
tr.#What would motivate you to use sustaina: Yürüme, bisiklet, toplu taşıma veya paylaşımlı araçlar gibi sürdürülebilir ulaşım seçeneklerini daha sık kullanmanızı ne teşvik ederdi?
tr.#More frequent and reliable public trans: Akşamları da dahil olmak üzere daha sık ve güvenilir toplu taşıma
tr.#Routes and vehicles that are accessible: Engelime veya sağlık durumuma uygun, erişilebilir güzergâhlar ve araçlar
tr.#I need the car for my situation (e.g.,: Durumum gereği arabaya ihtiyacım var (ör. engellilik, çocuklar, yük taşıma, vardiyalı çalışma)
tr.#I could not use them for health or disa: Sağlık veya engellilik nedeniyle bunları kullanamazdım
tr.#When delays occur (e.g., congestion, cr: Gecikmeler olduğunda, örneğin trafik sıkışıklığı veya kaza nedeniyle, stres düzeyiniz nasıl etkilenir?
tr.#How much do delays (e.g., traffic, cong: Gecikmeler (ör. trafik, sıkışıklık, kazalar) günlük programınızı ne kadar değiştiriyor?
tr.#How would increased driving-related cos: Yakıt, geçiş ücreti, otopark veya trafiğe kısıtlı bölgeler için giriş izni gibi otomobil kullanma maliyetleri artsaydı otomobil kullanımınız nasıl etkilenirdi?
tr.#How often is finding a parking space at: Gittiğiniz yerde park yeri bulmak ne sıklıkla sizin için sorun oluyor?
tr.#If you have a disabled parking permit:: Engelli park kartınız varsa: gittiğiniz yerdeki ayrılmış park yerleri ne sıklıkla başkaları tarafından işgal ediliyor veya hiç bulunmuyor?
